# Browser dependencies

These files are the published browser distributions. They are served locally.
No CDN or frontend build is required.

| Library | Version | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Markdown-it | 15.0.3 | https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-15.0.3.tgz |
| DOMPurify | 3.4.17 | https://registry.npmjs.org/dompurify/-/dompurify-3.4.17.tgz |

The adjacent license files come from those packages. Update the versions,
HTML references, and security tests together. Do not replace the sanitizer with
a custom parser.
